mechanism_narrative: Sustained recovery in WORKPLACES mobility (rising from -2.0 to +1.4 over four weeks) signals normalization of commuting patterns. Commuters generate incidental retail visits during work-week transit, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES increased 3.4 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the mean of the prior 28 days, or WORKPLACES reverses to negative territory within two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated GROCERY_PHARM mobility (40.7–43.3% above baseline) reflects sustained essential-goods purchasing behavior. Consumers making frequent pharmacy/grocery trips exhibit higher propensity for adjacent retail browsing, increasing RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM remained above 39% across all four weeks
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 30% in any week of the forecast period, or RETAIL_REC declines despite sustained GROCERY_PHARM elevation.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station usage has stabilized near baseline (−0.7% at t-0w) after weeks of suppression. When transit recovers above −1.0%, commuter foot traffic through retail corridors increases, lifting RETAIL_REC within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above −1.0% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from −3.4% at t-3w to −0.7% at t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT falls below −2.0% in the first two weeks of the forecast period, or RETAIL_REC shows no acceleration within two weeks of TRANSIT crossing −1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between elevated GROCERY_PHARM (42–43%) and recovering WORKPLACES (+1.1 to +1.4%) creates a dual-anchor effect: workers commute to offices and make essential stops, then extend trips to retail. This synergy drives RETAIL_REC upward over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:Both series show positive/near-positive values at t-0w
failure_condition: Either WORKPLACES or GROCERY_PHARM falls below their respective thresholds for more than one week, or RETAIL_REC declines despite both proxies meeting trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-September marks the onset of back-to-school and early autumn retail seasonality. PARKS mobility decline (−19.7% at t-0w) indicates outdoor activity suppression, redirecting consumer foot traffic indoors to retail venues, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS has remained below −15% for three consecutive weeks
failure_condition: PARKS recovers above −10% within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase despite sustained PARKS suppression.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility (4.4–5.9% above baseline) indicates sustained home-based activity. When combined with modest RETAIL_REC suppression (−1.9%), a policy-driven shift toward remote work or stay-at-home guidance is likely active. This regime will persist, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL elevated across all four weeks; RETAIL_REC consistently negative
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below 3.0% or WORKPLACES rises above +3.0%, signaling policy relaxation; or RETAIL_REC turns positive despite trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT suppression (−0.7% at t-0w, but still −3.4% at t-3w) reflects incomplete recovery of commuting infrastructure. If TRANSIT fails to cross zero within one week, commuters will not return to retail-adjacent corridors, and RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below 0 for the first week of the forecast period
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has not reached positive territory in any of the four observed weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT crosses above +1.0% within the first week, or RETAIL_REC rises above −0.5% despite TRANSIT remaining negative.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between suppressed PARKS (−19.7%) and elevated RESIDENTIAL (4.4%) indicates consumers are confined indoors. However, if GROCERY_PHARM remains elevated (42%), consumers will make essential trips but avoid discretionary retail. RETAIL_REC will remain flat or decline as essential-only behavior dominates over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:All three conditions met at t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS recovers above −10% or RESIDENTIAL falls below 3.5%, signaling behavioral shift; or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 2 percentage points despite all trigger conditions being met.
